Still using paper stamp cards?

The old way is easy to start, but hard to scale. Makan.la turns every visit into a trackable relationship you can actually grow from.

The old way

  • Cards get lost, forgotten, or damaged.
  • Staff has to remember rules and manually track visits.
  • No customer data, no visit history, no targeting.

The Makan.la way

  • A digital wallet pass that lives on the customer’s phone.
  • Automatic tracking of visits, rewards, and spend.
  • Customer insights you can use to bring people back with targeted offers.
